headline: PPL Corp., Blackstone spend $40.4M on possible Luzerne County power plants
summary: PPL Corporation and Blackstone Infrastructure spent more than $40 million to buy 500-plus acres in Jenkins, Plains and Salem townships for possible power plants to fuel data centers, a PPL spokesman said Thursday. “Our joint venture with Blackstone acquired land in Jenkins and Salem townships as we’re evaluating opportunities to meet rising demand for electricity in Pennsylvania,” said Ryan ...
